purpose.domain_detail: WMS (Warehouse Management System) parameters configuration screen for Promax ERP - configures integration settings between Promax and WMS systems (HBSIS, HighJump), printer settings, and interface options
purpose.summary: This program renders an HTML configuration screen for WMS (Warehouse Management System) parameters. It allows users to configure WMS system type, default printer for WMS returns, enabled interfaces (carregamento, conferencia OP, PCFisica, etc.), URL settings, and Pre-PCF options. It reads printer queue data from file PD99701 and populates a combo box.

notable_features: EXEC HTML ... END-EXEC (htmlpp preprocessor for web output)
OO COBOL class-control section with 'is class' syntax
invoke statement for OO method calls
$set compiler directives for preprocessor and source format
CGI/web form generation with HTML embedded in COBOL
external-form data item for CGI input
